title: Should Have Danced With Someone
author: Al Olson
problems: Row 2 "larks start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey needs one dancer at each end of the line, one on each side.
Row 4 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 4 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers who cross must face in across the set.
Row 5 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 7 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 8 "pass through across the set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 9 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 1 "larks start a left diagonal half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
